race.comment: I'M RELEVANT (6) ran a tidy third at his second race start, then scored a decisive on-pace victory over 1300m at Wyong on the soft (7) going. Dylan Gibbons retains the ride and he gets an even better set-up today. LEGO MASTER (3) consistent gelding who finally got off the mark first-up with a slick on-pace victory over 1200m at Illawarra Grange. Looked to have plenty up the sleeve on that occasion and no reason he can't repeat the effort today. ASILAH (5) resumes from a lengthy break. Scored a dominant win on debut, then chipped away late with to run fourth in a small field at Warwick Farm last February. Primed with the two good trials and has to overcome a sticky gate. Place preferred. WOODROW (2) went out a winner at Doomben, then returned with a tough on-pace second over 1125m at Grafton with the 61kg. Can measure up over the extra trip.
